summary: Phoenix Energy One, LLC filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 10 to its senior secured credit agreement. The amendment established $75 million in discretionary delayed-draw term loan commitments, fully drawn on the effective date, reducing remaining discretionary availability from $225 million to $150 million. The new loans carry a 3% original issue discount and match existing terms. The amendment also revised the repayment premium to achieve specified MOICs depending on loan group. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
